description: Live Bitcoin network health: hashrate, difficulty, transaction count, estimated volume, miner revenue and the largest recent mempool transactions (>10 BTC). Call for on-chain Bitcoin activity. Miner revenue is null when the source stops publishing it, never a misleading zero.
name: get_btc_network

btcLargeMempool.description: Largest transactions currently waiting in the mempool.

minersRevenueUsd.description: null when the source does not publish it. Never 0 - miner revenue cannot be zero while blocks are produced.
